svg.title: Ledger
svg.desc: - 2026-10-13: the agent eval with Codex (eval.py run-codex, GPT-6 Sol at high effort): 14/14 with the skill in the prompt and 14/14 as installed, zero critical failures by process.py; in every as-installed run Codex read its installed skill unprompted. README diagrams for the loop, WebKit, sign-in, handoff, profiles, the eval and speed, each with a phone layout; assets/charts.py draws the data ones from docs/evaluation/latency/results.json and docs/evaluation/regression/scores.json.
